topic: Complex Declaration Parsing and Operator Precedence in C
explanation: In advanced C programming, understanding complex declaration syntax and operator precedence is crucial for correctly interpreting and designing intricate data structures, such as nested pointers, function pointers, and multi-level arrays. Mastery of declaration parsing enables developers to write precise, efficient code and avoid subtle bugs caused by misinterpreted declarations, especially when dealing with layered types and advanced memory manipulations.
syntax: type-specifier *(*pointer_name)[size] | return_type (*function_pointer_name)(parameter_types) | union/struct declarations with nested types | complex combinations of pointers, arrays, and functions with correct precedence
